articles.title: Cooking Up Magick Book Review
articles.summary: The first book in a new series called The Dell Chronicles, HL Bernabe’s Cooking Up Magick sets out to be a cozier fantasy version of The Lord of the Rings. And in many ways, it does pull directly from J.R.R. Tolkien’s world.
body: The similarities to The Hobbit and LOTR pretty much end there though, and you don’t get nearly enough detail in the first book to effectively flesh out this alternate version of Middle-earth. What you do get is a lovable main character who is surrounded by an interesting cast of characters. There’s cooking, there’s magic, and there’s even a bit of romantasy thrown in here, but Cooking Up Magick doesn’t serve up enough of any of it to fully bring its story to life.

Cooking Up Magick shines brightest whenever the core characters are interacting with each other. Paisley is a bubbly bright spot among the crew, capable of immense courage and compassion. She has a sort of magnetism that rubs off on her friends and which helps shine a light on each of their individual personalities. Her conversations and moments with her newfound friends (and her Half-Orc love interest) really help to ground the story’s core concept of found family.
points: The first book in a new series called The Dell Chronicles, HL Bernabe’s Cooking Up Magick sets out to be a cozier fantasy version of The Lord of the Rings.
And in many ways, it does pull directly from J.R.R.
The similarities to The Hobbit and LOTR pretty much end there though, and you don’t get nearly enough detail in the first book to effectively flesh out this alternate version of Middle-earth.

articles.title: KPop Demon Hunters 2 Gets a Theatrical Release After First Movie's Smashing Success on Streaming
articles.summary: The KPop Demon Hunters sequel won’t be repeating the mistakes of its predecessor, having secured a guaranteed theatrical release following the first film’s smashing success.
body: The news was casually and somewhat unceremoniously buried in an October 20 report from The Hollywood Reporter, which dove into the events behind the departure of Netflix’s former film chief, Dan Lin.
According to THR, Lin helped secure a theatrical release for KPop Demon Hunters 2, a move that the outlet noted “hasn’t been officially announced.”

News of a sequel — er, more like sequels — was revealed in November 2025 when Variety reported that Netflix and Sony had inked a deal for a second animated film, with a release date planned for 2029. Around that same time, The Wrap revealed what’s next for the KPop Demon Hunters universe, including plans for a live-action movie, a stage play and two sequels to create a film trilogy. A spinoff series and short film were also mentioned, though none of these particular projects have been officially announced by the streamer.

articles.title: Forget ‘Carrie,’ Mike Flanagan’s Best Netflix Miniseries Is a Masterpiece From Start to Finish
articles.summary: Long before he was at the helm of the Prime Video adaptation of Stephen King's Carrie, Mike Flanagan made waves for himself with his trilogy of Netflix TV miniseries. His ability to helm works that combine horror and genuine human exploration.
body: Before that, however, one Flanagan project stuck with fans and viewers in ways a showrunner can only ever dream of. In a change of pace, this project stepped back from house-haunting and moved on to something bigger: faith. When faith is involved, the structure of the story changes.

Midnight Mass seems, on the surface, like a show about vampires. And while it is, the heart of it is something much more human than that. Allegorical for emotions like grief and loss, Midnight Mass pushes viewers to understand their own issues. It keeps the monsters out of sight for as long as possible, and once they are visible it's difficult to ever imagine having not seen them for what they are in the first place — much like in real life.

Set in Crockett Island, a tiny fishing community that has long since fallen into disrepair, the show follows Riley Flynn (Zach Gilford) as he moves back to the island after being released from prison. Things have changed for the worse since he was there last, and it doesn't seem like the community has much time left due to its dwindling population and fishing prospects.
points: Long before he was at the helm of the Prime Video adaptation of Stephen King's Carrie, Mike Flanagan made waves for himself with his trilogy of Netflix TV miniseries.
His ability to helm works that combine horror and genuine human exploration.

articles.title: The Chronicles of Narnia Books are on Sale at Amazon, Including a Deluxe Edition Hardcover
articles.summary: Amazon is currently running a buy 1, get 1 50% off sale on all of the Narnia books this week. The promotion extends to hardcovers, box sets, paperbacks, and even a massive 7-in-1 deluxe edition.
body: If you're only looking to read the source material for Gerwig's movie, you'll want to check out the deal on The Magician's Nephew first. The paperback, hardcover, and collector's edition are included in the sale. You can also get a copy of it in the box set or deluxe edition available here if you want the full collection instead.

Amazon has these types of sales pretty regularly and now is a particularly good time to buy multiple books at once. All you need to do is add two eligible books to your cart and Amazon will automatically apply the 50% discount to whichever one is the cheapest. This means you'll want to buy two similarly priced books to take full advantage of the discount.

So, for example, if you're looking to buy the deluxe edition at $39.50, you probably don't want to also buy The Magician's Nephew paperback for $7 at the same time. Instead you'll want to browse the sale for something closer to $40 to maximize your savings. Because of that, this sale usually works best if you're looking to get multiple copies of the same book at the same price point.

articles.title: Next-Gen Xbox Could Be $1,800 And Launch In 2028 – Report
articles.summary: A new report sheds more details on Microsoft's plans for new Xbox hardware, including a new handheld device and console, and one of the biggest takeaways is the alleged price.
body: According to Fortune, the Project Helix console could cost between $1,200 and $1,800, unless Microsoft opts to subsidize the cost. The system could launch in 2028, the report said.

It's not uncommon for platform-holders to eat some of the cost of a new console and make up the difference with software and services. When the Xbox Series X and S platforms launched in 2020, then-Xbox CEO Phil Spencer said Microsoft was losing as much as $200 on every console it sold.

Part of what might be driving up the price for new consoles is the ongoing AI-fueled memory and component shortages. Microsoft itself is one of the biggest proponents of the build-out of all things AI, so its own efforts are contributing to an environment where the next Xbox could be incredibly expensive. Xbox CEO Asha Sharma reacted to this irony, saying it's "wonderful" that GPUs have use beyong gaming.
Additionally, the report said Microsoft might release a "next-generation handheld device" for Xbox by the end of 2027, though there were no details on pricing or anything else.
points: A new report sheds more details on Microsoft's plans for new Xbox hardware, including a new handheld device and console, and one of the biggest takeaways is the alleged price.
According to Fortune, the Project Helix console could cost between $1,200 and $1,800, unless Microsoft opts to subsidize the cost.

articles.title: Red Rising Is Officially Returning In 2027
articles.summary: In the early 2010s, The Hunger Games captivated a generation, and in its wake came another dystopian tale set in the stars. Red Rising, a six-book saga by author Pierce Brown, traded the death-match arena for Mars, where a rigid, color-coded class system dictates daily life on the Red Planet.
body: Fast-forward to 2021, when Jamey Stegmaier of Stonemaier Games created and published a tabletop adaptation of Red Rising, bringing the Mars saga back into the spotlight. The board game was heavily based on the first three books in the series and was praised for its faithfulness to the source material. It allowed players to take command of rival houses and manage their cards to rise through the ranks of the dystopian society. Now, on the horizon for 2027, a digital adaptation of that board game is on the way.

A new digital adaptation of the critically acclaimed Red Rising board game is currently being developed by Canadian studio Emerald City Games. Much like Stegmaier stayed true to the source material when designing his board game, the developers at Emerald City are also making sure that their digital adaptation stays true to the original game.

articles.title: Here Are The Mechanics and Dozens Of New Cards From Magic: The Gathering’s Star Trek Set
articles.summary: After a year that featured alternate realities, ninja turtles, superheroes, and hobbits, the final Magic: The Gathering expansion of 2026 is going where no Universes Beyond set has gone before, as Star Trek is scheduled to launch in November.
body: Today, Wizards of the Coast revealed the mechanics players can expect in the set, along with dozens of new cards from both the main set and the preconstructed Commander decks. We also got a glimpse at some of the set's special treatments, including the seven cards that will come signed by the people depicted on the artwork.
Seven new mechanics--two of them found only in the Commander cards--highlight the set, along with a eighth mechanic returning from 2024's Edge of Eternities.

First is Beam Me Up, which allows you to cast certain spells from your graveyard by returning a creature you control to its owner's hand and paying a separate cost. The example card provided is Open Communications, which normally costs a single blue mana, but you can cast it again from your graveyard by returning a creature to its owner's hand and paying two generic and one blue mana.

articles.summary: Sony isn't the only company introducing new upscaling technology to its flagship PlayStation 5, as Microsoft and AMD have announced that FSR 4.1 is coming to more devices--including Xbox Series X|S consoles--in the future.
body: Similar to Sony's hardware-accelerated upscaling solutions for PS5 and PS5 Pro, AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution (FSR) 4.1 is an advanced, machine-learning-based temporal image upscaling and reconstruction technology that can render a game at a lower resolution and then upscale it to a higher resolution.

While it's highly doubtful that Xbox Series X|S consoles will start offering PS5 Pro-like graphics (both consoles lack dedicated hardware for machine-learning algorithms), this should still give owners a noticeable bump in graphical quality and performance if implemented properly.

Originally developed by Luxoflux and published by Activision, Shrek 2 is an action-adventure platformer based on DreamWorks Animation's hit 2004 film. Players travel through locations including Shrek's swamp, Fiona's castle and the kingdom of Far Far Away, revisiting scenes from the movie alongside additional sequences created for the game.

Players can control Shrek and other familiar characters, including Fiona and Donkey, as they fight enemies and tackle platforming challenges. The original game also supported cooperative play, letting up to four players join in locally.

articles.title: Henry Cavill’s Upcoming Sci-Fi Space Opera Series Writer Admits It's Been ‘Brutally Difficult’
articles.summary: Mike Flanagan has spent years bringing some of horror's most beloved stories to the screen, from Stephen King's Doctor Sleep to Netflix's The Haunting of Hill House. His latest King adaptation, Carrie, has earned rave reviews and is dominating streaming on Prime Video, but the filmmaker's next…
body: Speaking on The Process Unlocked podcast, Flanagan described the Amazon project, which he's developing alongside star and executive producer Henry Cavill, as feeling like he's “climbing my adaptation Everest.”

The challenge, he explained, is figuring out where to begin with a franchise that has accumulated decades of lore, hundreds of novels and thousands of years of fictional history, pointing to the franchise's enormous cast and sprawling timeline.

“These are novel lengths. These are not small. But there are so many characters. It takes place over so many thousands of years. There's so much there,” he said. “The challenge is how do you get in? That's really a brutally difficult adaptation, but it's been so fun for it.”

articles.title: Sony Boss: “Creativity Is For Humans, Not AI”
articles.summary: Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick and Sony Group President and CEO, Hiroki Totoki, commented on the future of gaming today at the Paley International Summit. Naturally, the topic of AI came up, and Totoki believes AI technologies will not replace humans in game development, in part because of the…
body: "Creativity is for humans, not AI,” Totoki said, as reported by IGN. “How to use the technology profile is important. Of course, I encourage my people to use AI in a certain manner, but at [the] same time we try to keep the rights and rights holders and creators and artists.”
For his part, Zelnick said it's his belief that AI itself will not replace a developer, but instead, people who don't embrace AI might be replaced by people who do.

"I’m fond of saying AI is a collection of datasets, compute, and large language models. That’s what it is. And datasets, by definition, are backward-looking. That’s all they are. And creativity, at its best, is forward-looking," he said.

Zelnick said ideas that are "completely unexpected" don't come from algorithms--they come from creative people making surprising, original choices. To make his point, Zelnick said when he was an executive at Fox, he oversaw the release of Home Alone, a movie that no one expected to be a success.

articles.title: EA Sports FC 27 gets a PEGI 16 rating in Europe because of loot boxes
articles.summary: European game rating agency PEGI has begun increasing its age ratings for games that contain "paid random items," a process that's seeing games initially rated as low as PEGI 3—suitable for all age groups—bounced directly to PEGI 16.
body: Word of the change came from Connor Hindle, policy manager of the UK's Games Rating Authority. "Since June, newly submitted games have been assessed against an expanded set of criteria within the PEGI rating framework, including new criteria relating to interactive risks," Hindle wrote on LinkedIn (via GamesIndustry ). "As the UK administrator of PEGI, the Games Rating Authority has now begun applying these updated criteria to selected existing digital products."

These changes were announced in March, and are part of PEGI's new "interactive risk categories" that include "purchases of in-game content, paid random items, communication features, and features that incentivise players to continue playing." The new categories reflect the ways we view videogames have changed: While rating systems like PEGI and ESRB were initially created over concerns about violence and sex in videogames, the real dangers turned out to be much more insidious.

articles.title: My favorite indie roguelike action RPG is tempting me to come back with a transformative new update inspired by Diablo seasons
articles.summary: Hell Clock, one of my favorite indie roguelike action RPGs in the last few years, found a way to take the appeal of limited-time Diablo seasons and make them permanent—no FOMO involved.
body: Its "Journeys" work much like Diablo and Path of Exile's seasons/leagues by transforming a normal run through the game with new toys to play with, but they won't disappear after a few months. The newest Journey, the Journey of Miracles, is now freely available for anyone who owns the game.

With the Journey of Miracles toggled on, you'll be able to earn powerful buffs for each run whenever you find a statue and survive the juiced up combat encounters they unleash. Some of these Divine Blessings you can grab are absurdly strong, like one that gives you the benefits of a Shrine (eg, extra movement speed, bonus XP gain, etc) by simply drinking a potion. There's a full list of what each one grants you on the Steam page, and I can tell some of them are designed to enable builds that weren't possible before.

articles.title: Ex-Call of Duty designer "who survived the crunch" in order to launch Black Ops 1 & 2 calls out executives "raking it in" from sales of remasters
articles.summary: A former long-time Call of Duty developer has called out Activision executives profiteering from the re-release of games like Black Ops 1 and 2, whereas the developers who contributed "blood, sweat, and tears" to make them gained nothing.
body: Gavin Goslin worked at Treyarch for more than 15 years as a level artist and level designer, and in a LinkedIn post reacting to low effort re-releases of Black Ops 1 & 2 this year, said: "They are printing money off of work completed over a decade ago.

"As a developer who actually worked on both BO1 and BO2, seeing these charts is bittersweet. I poured my life into those games, spending countless, brutal hours in crunch alongside an incredibly talented team to make sure they were perfect. Seeing our blood, sweat, and tears still dominating the charts in 2026 is amazing, but it's hard to watch the suits rake in giant financial windfalls from our old code while the actual creators don't see a dime of it."

The post was subsequently picked up by various gaming websites - a recirculation Goslin reacted to in a separate post on LinkedIn today. "I am glad this critical conversation is gaining traction," Goslin said.
